# youiyoux

> UI context and verification for coding agents. Before writing a UI component, call the MCP tool `ui_find_component` with the need in words and reuse what it names. After UI edits, run `npx -y youiyoux check --diff` and apply each fix. After changing a component, call `ui_render` and look at the screenshots. `npx youiyoux` writes a shareable report on any repo.

Set up a repo with `npx youiyoux agents install` (a rule in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, the `youiyoux` MCP server for Claude Code and Codex). Everything runs locally; all MCP tools are read-only. Exit codes: 0 done (check --diff is advisory), 1 findings with --strict or a failure, 2 usage error.

## Docs

- [Agent reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/youiyoux/main/docs/agents.md): when to call each MCP tool, real example output, reading check --diff, hooks, exit codes, JSON output
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/youiyoux/main/README.md): what youiyoux is, quickstart, use cases
- [Command reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/youiyoux/main/docs/commands.md): every command and flag in detail

## Optional

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/youiyoux): `npx youiyoux`, Node 20 or later
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/youiyoux/main/AGENTS.md): for agents changing youiyoux itself
